@kabelodick @Cyza @EFFSouthAfrica I explained why we seek to advance the interests of black people& explained  #PutSouthAfricaFirst struggle in the context of #blacklivesmatter in a similar contexted as explained by Ndlozi.

I think your friends are not reading my tweets & think that I am asking for validation

@Cyza We believe that it is in our interest as South Africa to wage our struggle within the context of the global struggle by black people.  U cannot say that you are in support #BlackLivesMatter then isolate yourself from the entire black struggle.  If you listened u would understand

@VincentMailola @Mellow_Rocker It has everything to do with what is happening today.  We say #BlackLivesMatter & we locate ourselves within the struggle of black people. #PutSouthAfricaFirst are defenders of colonial structures & racists, which keep Africans divided for the continued benefit of the colonizers
